output_list.code: function changeFree(uint newFree) public {        free = newFree;    }
output_list.reason: This function can only be executed by the contract owner and is supposed to be called before deployment. The current initial state is the free balance for all existing address is 0. The free balance can be set to a higher value, thus enabling more tokens to be sent to these addresses. If no other logic is provided, this function can be exploited to give a large amount of free token to malicious actors.
